payload.title: Tally ERP to Cloud Migration
payload.description: Migrate 15 years of Tally Prime data — inventory, GST returns, payroll — to a cloud ERP with zero downtime during peak dispatch season (October–December). Budget reallocated internally after leadership review.
requirements: Tally Prime data extraction and validation
Staff training in Marathi and Hindi

payload.notes: Client deferred — budget reallocated to fleet expansion. Revisit Q1 2027 with phased Tally-to-cloud approach.
